note: These are deterministic scripted controls, not model performance.

tasks.instruction: Use the two beakers to form silver chloride and a second, different precipitate. Leave both solids on the bench.
tasks.expectedOutcome: AgCl and a different precipitate remain in separate beakers.

requirements.description: AgCl reaction and deposited solid remain
The two deposits are in different containers

tasks.instruction: Prepare 100 mL of 0.10 M NaCl in the beaker from 1.0 M stock and water.
tasks.expectedOutcome: Beaker c_2 holds 100 mL and 0.010 mol NaCl.

tasks.instruction: Measure the starting pH, then bring the challenge beaker to pH 7.0 ± 0.1 using the weak acid stock. Leave the pH meter attached.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A measured, neutralized beaker with attached pH meter.

requirements.description: Initial pH measured before reagent addition

tasks.instruction: Measure flask pH, add phenolphthalein, titrate with the burette through the endpoint, and submit the acid concentration.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A recorded curve across equivalence and a submitted concentration within 2% of the hidden value.

requirements.description: pH meter attached and curve contains measured points
Curve spans the independently calculated equivalence volume
Submitted concentration within 2% of hidden value

tasks.instruction: In the starting beaker, combine sodium carbonate and enough hydrochloric acid to release CO2. Leave liquid in the beaker.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A gas reaction record and liquid in the original beaker.

tasks.instruction: Measure 10 mL of 1.0 M NaCl in the graduated cylinder, transfer it into the beaker, and dilute the beaker to 100 mL of 0.10 M.
tasks.expectedOutcome: Cylinder measured and transferred; beaker meets volume and concentration targets.

requirements.description: Cylinder volume was measured before transfer
Stock moved from cylinder to beaker
